title: Les Bleus and the Atlas Lions kick off blockbuster World Cup quarter-finals
summary: France and Morocco are facing each other on July 9 as the World Cup's blockbuster quarter-finals kick off. On the other side of the draw, holders Argentina face Switzerland in Kansas City on July 11 after staggering into the quarter-finals following their last-minute win against Egypt, while England and Norway will also face each other down.
